news.Title: Silicon Motion Technology Corporation (SIMO) is Attracting Investor Attention: Here is What You Should Know
news.Content:
Silicon Motion (SIMO) is one of the stocks most watched by Zacks.com visitors lately. So, it might be a good idea to review some of the factors that might affect the near-term performance of the stock.

Over the past month, shares of this chip company have returned -33.5%, compared to the Zacks S&P 500 composite's -2.3% change. During this period, the Zacks Computer - Integrated Systems industry, which Silicon Motion falls in, has lost 21.9%. The key question now is: What could be the stock's future direction?

While media releases or rumors about a substantial change in a company's business prospects usually make its stock 'trending' and lead to an immediate price change, there are always some fundamental facts that eventually dominate the buy-and-hold decision-making.

Revisions to Earnings Estimates

Rather than focusing on anything else, we at Zacks prioritize evaluating the change in a company's earnings projection. This is because we believe the fair value for its stock is determined by the present value of its future stream of earnings.

We essentially look at how sell-side analysts covering the stock are revising their earnings estimates to reflect the impact of the latest business trends. And if earnings estimates go up for a company, the fair value for its stock goes up. A higher fair value than the current market price drives investors' interest in buying the stock, leading to its price moving higher. This is why empirical research shows a strong correlation between trends in earnings estimate revisions and near-term stock price movements.

Silicon Motion is expected to post earnings of $4.75 per share for the current quarter, representing a year-over-year change of +277%. Over the last 30 days, the Zacks Consensus Estimate has changed +13.1%.

The consensus earnings estimate of $12.91 for the current fiscal year indicates a year-over-year change of +263.7%. This estimate has changed -5.5% over the last 30 days.

For the next fiscal year, the consensus earnings estimate of $19.86 indicates a change of +53.9% from what Silicon Motion is expected to report a year ago. Over the past month, the estimate has changed +28.5%.

With an impressive externally audited track record, our proprietary stock rating tool -- the Zacks Rank -- is a more conclusive indicator of a stock's near-term price performance, as it effectively harnesses the power of earnings estimate revisions. The size of the recent change in the consensus estimate, along with three other factors related to earnings estimates, has resulted in a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) for Silicon Motion.

Story Continues

The chart below shows the evolution of the company's forward 12-month consensus EPS estimate:

12 Month EPS

Revenue Growth Forecast

While earnings growth is arguably the most superior indicator of a company's financial health, nothing happens as such if a business isn't able to grow its revenues. After all, it's nearly impossible for a company to increase its earnings for an extended period without increasing its revenues. So, it's important to know a company's potential revenue growth.

In the case of Silicon Motion, the consensus sales estimate of $602.1 million for the current quarter points to a year-over-year change of +116.2%. The $1.94 billion and $2.72 billion estimates for the current and next fiscal years indicate changes of +118.8% and +40.6%, respectively.

Last Reported Results and Surprise History

Silicon Motion reported revenues of $560.22 million in the last reported quarter, representing a year-over-year change of +131.5%. EPS of $4.35 for the same period compares with $1 a year ago.

Compared to the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $532.81 million, the reported revenues represent a surprise of +5.14%. The EPS surprise was +31.82%.

Over the last four quarters, Silicon Motion surpassed consensus EPS estimates three times. The company topped consensus revenue estimates each time over this period.

Valuation

Without considering a stock's valuation, no investment decision can be efficient. In predicting a stock's future price performance, it's crucial to determine whether its current price correctly reflects the intrinsic value of the underlying business and the company's growth prospects.

While comparing the current values of a company's valuation multiples, such as price-to-earnings (P/E), price-to-sales (P/S), and price-to-cash flow (P/CF), with its own historical values helps determine whether its stock is fairly valued, overvalued, or undervalued, comparing the company relative to its peers on these parameters gives a good sense of the reasonability of the stock's price.

The Zacks Value Style Score (part of the Zacks Style Scores system), which pays close attention to both traditional and unconventional valuation metrics to grade stocks from A to F (an A is better than a B; a B is better than a C; and so on), is pretty helpful in identifying whether a stock is overvalued, rightly valued, or temporarily undervalued.

Silicon Motion is graded D on this front, indicating that it is trading at a premium to its peers. Click here to see the values of some of the valuation metrics that have driven this grade.

Bottom Line

The facts discussed here and much other information on Zacks.com might help determine whether or not it's worthwhile paying attention to the market buzz about Silicon Motion. However, its Zacks Rank #3 does suggest that it may perform in line with the broader market in the near term.

news.Title: ASML Surges 48% in the Past Year: How Should You Play the Stock Now?
news.Content:
ASML Holding N.V. ASML has gained 48.1% over the past year compared with the sector's growth of 9.5%. It has outperformed Advanced Energy Industries, Inc. AEIS but lagged Silicon Motion Technology Corporation SIMO. While AEIS has gained 11.4%, SIMO soared 103.6% over this period.

One-Year ASML Stock Price Performance

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

ASML Rides on Strong AI Demand

ASML is benefiting from growing AI infrastructure investments, which are encouraging leading semiconductor manufacturers to expand their production capabilities. The company's Installed Base Management revenues reached €3.29 billion in the third quarter of 2026, increasing from €2.76 billion in the preceding quarter, driven by strong demand for productivity upgrades. New lithography system sales increased to 113 units from 86 in the second quarter.

Management highlighted improving order momentum, with some customers expressing interest in placing equipment orders for 2029 and 2030. The combination of capacity growth and higher lithography content gives ASML multiple structural avenues for revenue expansion through 2026 and beyond.

The company's dominant position in extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography technology provides a competitive advantage, particularly as chipmakers expand production of advanced logic and memory chips. ASML's expanding technological capabilities, strategic partnerships and improving financial outlook further strengthen its investment appeal. The company is advancing High Numerical Aperture (High-NA) EUV technology, which is expected to support next-generation semiconductor manufacturing and drive long-term equipment demand. Its expanding collaborations with Intel, Samsung and TSMC reinforce its position in advanced chipmaking.

Estimate Revision Trend

Earnings estimates for ASML for 2026 have moved up 54.4% to $46.54 over the past year, while the same for 2027 has increased 61.9% to $62.54. The positive estimate revision depicts bullish sentiment about the stock's growth potential.

ASML Growth Marred by Long Order Visibility

Despite the positives, management attributes the current demand environment primarily to AI-related investment and the resulting need for more advanced Logic and Memory capacity. This has produced unusually long order visibility for ASML, but it also makes the growth profile increasingly dependent on customers maintaining those expansion plans. A slower pace of customer investment would therefore affect both system demand and utilization of the larger production footprint ASML is preparing.

The planned scale-up requires manufacturing capacity, suppliers and trained employees to rise together. This leaves future profitability dependent on converting the larger cost base into the expected shipment volumes. Moreover, a uniform adoption schedule across Logic and DRAM customers is yet to be established. High-NA therefore remains both a technology opportunity and an execution variable, with the pace of wider insertion dependent on customer qualification and manufacturing decisions rather than ASML's roadmap alone.

Story Continues

Other Headwinds

ASML also faces operational challenges related to capacity expansion, supply-chain constraints and the growing complexity of its advanced lithography systems. In its third-quarter 2026 update, management indicated that planned production capacity for 2027 and 2028 would not fully meet anticipated customer demand, highlighting potential execution risks as the company scales manufacturing operations. Expanding capacity requires substantial investments, specialized components and a highly skilled workforce, while supplier bottlenecks could delay system deliveries and revenue recognition. In addition, developing and commercializing next-generation High-NA EUV technology requires significant R&D spending that could weigh on ASML's growth prospects.

End Note

ASML's technological leadership in EUV lithography, healthy order trends and expanding installed-base revenues reinforce its long-term investment appeal. With upward earnings estimate revisions, the stock is witnessing positive investor sentiment. However, export-control uncertainties, capacity-expansion challenges and long order visibility remain headwinds.

Stiff competitive pressure and supply-chain bottlenecks also plague the company's growth prospects. High operating and R&D expenses remain an overhang as well. With a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), ASML appears to be treading in the middle of the road, and investors could be better off if they trade with caution. news.Title: Should You Trade SIMO Stock With Caution Despite Q3 Earnings Beat?
news.Content:
Silicon Motion Technology Corporation SIMO reported strong third-quarter 2026 results, with both the top and bottom lines surpassing the Zacks Consensus Estimate. Non-GAAP earnings of $4.35 per American Depositary Share (ADS) increased 335% year over year and beat the consensus estimate of $3.30 by 31.82%.

Revenues surged 131% year over year to approximately $560 million, exceeding the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $533 million by 5.07%. Growth was supported by robust demand for SSD controllers and Ferri & Boot Drive solutions, with the latter witnessing a remarkable 2,580-2,585% year-over-year sales increase.

SIMO Buoyed by Healthy Demand Trends

Silicon Motion is witnessing solid growth dynamics driven by strong momentum in enterprise and edge SSD controllers, automotive storage solutions and enterprise boot drive products. SSD controller sales increased 55-60% year over year and 20-25% sequentially, benefiting from expanding demand for edge and enterprise storage applications. Sales of embedded Multi-Media Card and Universal Flash Storage (eMMC+UFS) controllers rose 35-40% year over year.

Ferri & Boot Drive solutions sales increased 75-80% sequentially, supported by rapid adoption of automotive, edge artificial intelligence (AI) and enterprise boot drive solutions. Management highlighted growing contributions from its MonTitan enterprise and AI controllers as the company expands beyond traditional consumer storage markets.

Fabless Business Model Aids SIMO

Silicon Motion operates a fabless business model, focusing on chip design while outsourcing manufacturing to foundries like TSMC. Consequently, the company has a low capital investment requirement as it does not require expensive fabrication plants, enabling it to adopt advanced manufacturing nodes quickly, leading to higher margins compared to integrated manufacturers. This enables the company to focus on innovation and product development rather than manufacturing complexity.

The key growth drivers for SIMO include AI and high-performance computing, cloud data centers, automotive storage, smartphones and mobile devices. Each of these end markets is growing fast and offers lucrative growth potential. An expanding customer base and innovative products will likely act as tailwinds for the company's top-line growth. Silicon Motion has shipped more than 10 billion NAND flash controllers in its operating history, with more than 750 million NAND controllers on average every year.

Price Performance

SIMO has gained 103.6% over the past year compared with the industry's growth of 101.5%. It has also outperformed peers like Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. AMD and International Business Machines Corporation IBM. Advanced Micro has gained 86.7%, while IBM is down 16.1% over this period.

Story Continues

One-Year SIMO Stock Price Performance

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

Stiff Competition, Geopolitical Issues Hurt SIMO

Despite the positives, Silicon Motion faces stiff competition in the mobile storage market from players like Micron, Microchip, Marvell and ON Semiconductor. Of late, intensifying competition in the card and USB flash drive controller markets is proving to be a major headwind. The tense political conditions between Taiwan and the People's Republic of China increase the extent of political risk for the company. Moreover, North Korea's nuclear and ballistic missile testing programs, deteriorating relationship with South Korea, leadership woes and strained relations with the United States are likely to affect its business. In addition, high R&D costs have adversely impacted its margins.

Estimate Revision Trend

Earnings estimates for SIMO for 2026 have moved up 164.5% to $12.91 over the past year, while the same for 2027 has increased 203.7% to $19.86. The positive estimate revision depicts bullish sentiment about the stock's growth potential.

End Note

With solid fundamentals and healthy revenue-generating potential, driven by robust demand trends, Silicon Motion is poised for long-term growth. Further, a strong emphasis on quality, diligent execution of operational plans and continuous portfolio enhancements are driving more value for customers. An asset-light fabless semiconductor model, solid growth exposure to AI, cloud and automotive markets, increasing market share in SSD and mobile controllers and continuous innovation in storage technologies are key growth drivers for the company. With upward earnings estimate revisions, the stock is witnessing positive investor sentiment.

However, stiff competition and supply chain issues are likely to put pressure on the bottom-line growth. High R&D costs erode its profitability to a large extent. Silicon Motion is facing a tough operating environment amid tense geopolitical conditions across the globe. With a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), Silicon Motion appears to be treading in the middle of the road, and investors could be better off if they trade with caution. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks #1 Rank (Strong Buy) stocks here .

news.Title: 華邦電法說會》總座示警第4季營運恐降溫 分析師：記憶體榮景恐要結束
news.Content:
記憶體大廠華邦電（2344）第三季財報表現強勁，單季大賺354.22億元且EPS衝上7.58元，但公司警示第四季受PC等消費性需求放緩影響，營運動能將不如前幾季。分析師坦言「記憶體族群的派對恐怕即將結束」，雖然短線因先前股價修正過後可能出現跌深反彈，但後續恐難再重演先前的強勁漲勢。

記憶體大廠華邦電（2344）3日公布第三季財報，單季大賺354.22億元年增1103.5%，EPS衝上7.58元。

華邦電總經理陳沛銘於法說會指出，目前產業呈「AI強、非AI弱」雙軌分化。受到PC等消費性客戶第四季拉貨動能放緩影響，第四季營運成長力道將不如前幾季，但長線來看，2027年記憶體缺貨情況恐比今年更為嚴峻，獲利動能依然無虞。

回顧台股3日重挫逾1600點拖累，記憶體指標股同步受壓。隨著華邦電警示第四季旺季不旺，市場高度關心4日股價開盤表現及產業循環高點是否已現。 記憶體族群近期走勢分歧，市場高度關注產業景氣是否已步入循環高點？對此，資深台股分析師蔡明翰指出，「party恐怕快要結束。」

蔡明翰說明，當蘋果（Apple）開始將上游零組件成本轉嫁給消費者，這正宣告記憶體產業的「榮景派對」恐面臨轉折，基本面再向上突破的難度大增。投資人操作上應把握「反彈分批減碼」原則，避免在低點急於殺低。

蔡明翰補充，記憶體此前受惠於價格上揚與備貨潮，帶動相關概念股強勢上攻。隨著供應鏈成本大幅增加，指標性廠商蘋果已被迫透過調漲終端產品售價來轉嫁成本。這意味著消費端承受度將面臨考驗，一旦終端銷售動能受阻，上游零組件的拉貨力道必然隨之放緩，成為記憶體市況高點反轉的關鍵前哨警訊。

「華邦電示警第 4 季營運放緩 ， 驗證基本面疲態。」蔡明翰進一步指出，華邦電第四季營運動能出現放緩跡象，顯示終端需求降溫已開始侵蝕業者營運表現。在缺乏更強勁的基本面利多支撐下，記憶體族群後續營運要再創造超預期的爆發性成長，難度相當高。

針對近期記憶體族群的急跌走勢，蔡明翰認為，股價短線遭遇重挫後，技術面已呈超跌態勢，隨時有機會迎來技術性反彈。因此，投資人在操作上「切勿在低點急於砍單」，應靜待個股回溫反彈時，再採取「逢高逐步減碼」的應對策略，以控制投資組合風險。

news.Title: 〈華邦電法說〉明年記憶體供給恐比今年更吃緊 斥731億元擴建高雄廠
news.Content:
華邦電(2344-TW)今(3)日召開法說，經營團隊認為，明年記憶體供給仍相當吃緊，甚至可能比今年更緊俏，預計狀況延續到2028年；為因應後續需求，華邦電董事會也通過731億元資本支出案，主要用於高雄廠Module B擴建。

華邦電表示，除了AI伺服器外，Edge AI、車用及基礎建設等應用也將持續帶動記憶體需求，尤其DDR3、DDR4及LPDDR4等成熟製程產品，隨部分大廠減少供應，華邦電將持續滿足長期合作客戶需求。

產能規劃方面，華邦電高雄Module A廠目前月產能約16K，預計今年底提升至24K，屆時產能將達滿載，2027及2028年也預計維持在24K。至於Module B廠，規劃產能約為Module A的兩倍，預估可達50K至60K，並將採用16奈米製程，提高單位產能的位元產出。

華邦電預計12月29日舉行Module B動工儀式，目標2029年下半年開始少量出貨，2030年逐步開出完整產能。目前已與多家客戶洽談長期供貨合約(LTA)，提前確保2029年以後的產能需求，部分客戶甚至已針對未來LPDDR5等產品提出合作規劃。

此外，華邦電也持續推進16奈米製程，目前月產能約2K，預計逐步擴增至16K，2027年1月起增加投片，經過約半年製程週期後，預期明年下半年可望放量，屆時16奈米產品營收占比有機會超過40%，主要支援DDR4及LPDDR4需求。

資本支出方面，華邦電原預估2026年全年記憶體資本支出約395億元，主要投入晶圓生產製造，約占95%；此次董事會通過的731億元則是針對高雄Module B所需的新增投資規劃，包括廠房土建、機電設備及記憶體製程設備等，兩者涵蓋範圍及用途不同。

news.Title: 〈華邦電法說〉Q3大賺354億元季增45%、EPS 7.58元 Q4營運續向上
news.Content:
華邦電(2344-TW)今(3)日召開法說並公告第三季財報，稅後純益354.22億元，季增45.7%、年增11倍，每股純益7.58元，累計前三季每股純益15.32元。展望第四季，雖然消費性電子需求略有修正，但受惠AI相關需求仍強勁，公司預期整體營運仍可成長。

華邦電指出，第四季市場呈現兩極化，AI相關需求持續強勁，但非AI應用受到消費性電子及PC客戶經過前三季備貨後調整拉貨影響，需求相對疲弱；不過，隨部分客戶合約陸續到期，第四季DRAM報價預期仍有調漲空間，只是漲幅可能不如第三季。

華邦電第三季營收823.31億元，季增37.6%、年增278%；毛利率70.6%，季增4個百分點、年增24個百分點、營益率53.2%、季增5個百分點、年增36個百分點。

華邦電表示，第三季營收成長主要來自記憶體業務，其中客製化記憶體(CMS)占合併營收比重已提升至58%、Flash占32%，邏輯IC則降至9%；單看記憶體事業，第三季營收達742.84億元，毛利率達73.9%，營業利益率達59.8%，產能利用率也已接近100%，成為帶動整體獲利成長的主要動能。

進一步觀察產品表現，第三季CMS(客製化記憶體解決方案)營收季增50%，位元出貨量略減，但平均銷售單價(ASP)大漲約60%；Flash營收則季增34%，位元出貨量大致持平，ASP也成長逾30%。華邦電指出，CMS出貨量略減，主要是預留部分產能給長期合作客戶，以因應後續產能需求。

應用別方面，網通應用營收季增55%，占記憶體事業營收比重31%，主要受惠AI伺服器機櫃內的交換器及網路設備需求增加；電腦應用營收季增66%，占比由第二季15%提升至17%，此外，車用及工業應用營收季增36%，消費性電子也成長35%，占比分別為26%。

news.Title: 華邦電通過731億元資本支出　高雄新廠擬12/29動工
news.Content:
（中央社記者張建中台北2026年11月3日電）記憶體廠華邦電 (2344) 董事會今天通過新台幣731.63億元資本支出，將用於擴建高雄廠廠房及購置生產設備，總經理陳沛銘表示，高雄廠模組B將於12月29日動工，希望2年內可以開始裝機。

華邦電今天召開法人說明會，陳沛銘指出，高雄廠模組A預計今年底月產能擴增到2.4萬至2.5萬片規模，2027年及2028年將維持月產能2.4萬至2.5萬片。

陳沛銘說，董事會今天核准731.63億元資本支出，將用於高雄廠模組B建廠及購置生產設備，預計12月29日舉行簡單動工儀式，希望2年內可以開始裝機，2029年小量產，2030年較大量貢獻產能。

陳沛銘表示，人工智慧（AI）市場需求依然強勁，不過，第4季消費性市場恐面臨修正。AI將成為人類生活不可或缺的一部分，預期AI不會泡沫，只是可能會加速洗牌，部分廠商的投資會泡沫。

陳沛銘指出，華邦電目前居全球編碼型快閃記憶體（NOR Flash）龍頭，單層式儲存型快閃記憶體（SLCNAND Flash）為世界第3，隨著大廠陸續淡出市場，華邦電可望擴展市場，將朝向全球SLC NAND Flash龍頭目標邁進。

至於客製化記憶體方面，陳沛銘說，華邦電將以DDR4及LPDDR4產品為發展重心。

至於產品價格走勢，陳沛銘表示，目前動態隨機存取記憶體（DRAM）價格已高，不過，不至於會下跌。Flash產品價格仍有往上空間，尤其是高容量。

受惠客製化記憶體與Flash產品價格上漲，華邦電第3季營收攀高至新台幣823.31億元，季增37.6%，毛利率70.6%，較第2季上揚4個百分點，歸屬母公司淨利354.22億元，季增45.7%，每股純益7.58元，累計前3季每股純益15.32元。

news.Title: 華邦電Q4消費性需求修正，惟合約價續漲10~20%
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-03 17:37:09 周佩宇 發佈

華邦電(2344)總經理陳沛銘(附圖)今(3)日指出，今(2026)年第四季DRAM及Flash價格均可望續漲，漲幅約10%至20%，並看好2027年、2028年營運優於2026年。對2029年新產能開出的下半年也持樂觀看法，但仍須觀察屆時市況；以目前客戶需求來看，即使高雄廠Module B各階段產能全部開出，供給仍可能不足。儘管2026年第四季手機、家電及消費型筆電需求較弱、客戶整理庫存，華邦仍傾向保留產品予長約客戶。

為降低新產能開出後的需求風險，華邦也洽談長期供貨合作，選擇產品路線相符的策略客戶，涵蓋2029年新產能開出後至2032年的需求，目前有意洽談者已超過10家。合作模式包含客戶支付預付款或訂金，支應設備投資，再由未來產品供應回饋，各家條件分別協商。陳沛銘強調，除當下需求，也重視客戶長期產品規劃，例如車用客戶由LPDDR4逐步轉向LPDDR5，就與華邦後續布局較為契合；標準型DDR5則不會積極搶進，大廠轉向DDR5後留下的DDR4供給缺口，仍有可觀市場。

擴產方面，董事會此次通過的731億元投資，包含Module B土建、機電與長交期設備，尚未納入全部正常及短交期設備，後續仍將分階段追加，並非一次建滿月產6萬片。Module B預計年底動土，2029年開出新產能，產品將由16奈米DDR4往14奈米及更先進製程推進，後續亦規劃購買EUV設備。既有Module A由月產1.6萬片擴至2.4萬片的設備正陸續交付，成為2027年資本支出重點；2027年現金基礎資本支出將高於2026年的395億元，Module B此次核准的731億元投資，也有部分款項會到2028年底支付。華邦也持續向政府尋求新用地，評估下一階段擴產，但地點與時程尚未確定。

新業務方面，矽電容已小量出貨，初期規劃的幾千片產能已售罄，正持續擴充供給，並已有大型MLCC廠商採用；陳沛銘表示，目前對華邦整體營收貢獻仍有限，後續將推進更高電容密度產品。CUBE則預計2027年量產，客戶主力為AI ASIC，多用於推論，已有客戶提出四層堆疊及與SoC整合的需求。

news.Title: 華邦電看明後年供需維持緊張，砸731億元續擴產
news.Content:
MoneyDJ新聞 2026-11-03 17:23:58 周佩宇 發佈

華邦電(2344)今(3)日召開法說會，總經理陳沛銘(附圖中)看好記憶體供需持續緊俏，第四季客製化記憶體（CMS）合約價格仍有上漲空間，同時高容量NOR Flash價格上行趨勢可望延續至明(2027)年；他並指出，業界普遍認為2027年供需將比2026年更緊，2028年可能維持相近程度。

華邦電第三季合併營收823.31億元、季增37.6%，毛利率70.6%、季增逾4個百分點，歸屬母公司稅後淨利354.22億元、季增45.7%，每股盈餘7.58元；前三季累計每股盈餘15.32元。董事會今日也通過上半年度股利政策，每股將配發2元現金股利。

產品方面，第三季CMS營收季增50%、占合併營收58%，混合平均售價季增近60%，位元出貨量則季減高個位數百分比，20奈米DDR4、LPDDR4仍為主要成長動能；Flash營收季增34%、占比32%，位元出貨量季持平、混合平均售價季增約三成，其中24奈米營收貢獻提高，高容量NOR營收與出貨占比同步創高。展望2027年，高容量NOR供給持續吃緊，SLC NAND亦有新案導入支撐價格；AI伺服器、車用及基礎架構需求延續，DDR3、DDR4缺貨也帶來過去未有合作的基礎架構客戶。

目前華邦電DRAM在PC與伺服器的銷售規模仍小，陳沛銘預期2027年將明顯成長，尤其看好伺服器需求，電腦應用占記憶體營收比重可望較第三季17%明顯提高；車用則是AI之外較有掌握的成長領域，客戶產品替換不易，長期供貨需求持續。

為因應長期需求，華邦電董事會通過731億元資本支出案，主要投入高雄廠Module B建設與設備，預計12月底動土，目標兩年內完成裝機，無塵室規劃月產能5萬至6萬片。高雄廠既有Module A產能已滿，2027年、2028年月產能維持約2.4萬片，在新產能到位前，公司須提前保留部分產品與庫存，以履行長期供貨安排，Module B長期供貨協議（LTA）也持續洽談。

製程升級方面，16奈米已開始放量，預期2027年帶來顯著營收貢獻，陳沛銘看好2027年下半年占比進一步提高；2027年產品仍聚焦DDR4、LPDDR4，並持續供應DDR3，滿足車用、工業等客戶長期需求。

其他布局方面，CUBE進度如期，預計2027年進入量產並逐步增加產能；收購英飛凌NOR Flash與F-RAM事業案，則待取得主管機關核准，預計2027年下半年完成交割，交易後將以Spansion為名維持獨立營運，保有自身銷售與設計團隊。對整體市況，華邦電仍留意通膨、利率對消費支出及傳統電子需求的影響，但認為AI需求持續支撐記憶體上升循環，自身獲利動能維持強勁，經營上將重視長期供貨關係，而非單純追求最高價格。

news.Title: European shares falls as Apple margin warning triggers global tech rout
news.Content:
Investing.com - European shares declined on Tuesday, succumbing to a worldwide sell-off across technology bourses after Apple warned of margin compression from rising chip costs, while a $20 billion capital raise by Oracle reignited investor anxiety over artificial intelligence funding and cash burn.

Still guessing which stocks will beat the market? Our AI portfolio updates monthly and is outperforming the S&P 500 by 118%. See this month's list »

The pan-European STOXX 600 index dropped 0.6%, while Germany's DAX fell 0.3%. France's CAC 40 fell 0.3% while London's FTSE 100 declined 1.1%.

The drawdown was led by the technology sector after Apple warned that persistent inflation in memory chip prices would squeeze gross margins through the crucial holiday shopping quarter.

The continent's semiconductor ecosystem - including lithography giant ASML, assembly equipment makers ASM International and BE SemiconductoR all fell between 2% and 4% and chip suppliers STMicroelectronics and Infineon - trades as a direct proxy for global consumer electronics hardware and datacenter supply chains - fell over 3% each.

With the world's most valuable tech platform signaling that higher component bills are eroding profitability, European semiconductor suppliers came under sharp selling pressure amid fears that hardware makers will either absorb margin compression or face demand destruction if input expenses are passed on to consumers.

The hardware chill was compounded by news that enterprise software giant Oracle plans to raise $20 billion through a combination of bond and share sales to fund its aggressive cloud infrastructure and datacenter expansion.

"Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft, Tesla and Apple have now all released their latest quarterly results and been met with varying degrees of scepticism, so all eyes are now switching to Nvidia's third-quarter numbers that are due on 17 November," said AJ Bell's investment director, Russ Mould.

This week, about 20% of the STOXX 600 companies are expected to report their quarterly results, marking one of the busiest stretches of the European third-quarter earnings season.

German airline group Lufthansa saw its shares gain 1.6%. The management narrowed its full-year 2026 operating profit forecast due to soaring jet fuel costs tied to Middle Eastern supply tensions.

Conversely, healthcare giants helped cushion tech loses. Dutch medical technology heavyweight Koninklijke Philips advanced 6% after posting higher quarterly profit.

Story Continues

Bayer surged 6% after the German pharma group beat analyst expectations on both revenue and operating profit, while simultaneously lifting its full-year outlook.

U.S. midterms test Trump's second-term agenda

Cross-asset flows were further restrained by caution ahead of Tuesday's U.S. midterm elections, with American voters heading to the polls to deliver a referendum on the first two years of President Donald Trump's second term.

A Democratic-controlled or divided Congress would introduce legislative gridlock, slowing domestic deregulatory momentum and raising the stakes for upcoming federal debt ceiling negotiations, while potentially curbing federal spending initiatives.

With investors also awaiting Friday's October U.S. nonfarm payrolls report to gauge the Federal Reserve's December interest-rate trajectory, dealing desks maintained low risk profiles across European bourses.

Among other earnings moves, Truecaller fell 17% after the Stockholm-listed caller-identification company reported a third-quarter net loss and issued a cautious outlook on user growth.

TeamViewer fell as much as 18% after lowering its full-year revenue growth forecast.

news.Title: KLA Stocks Rise 1.42% With Target Cut Contrasting Its December Growth Plan
news.Content:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus .

KLA ( NASDAQ:KLAC ) has a growth target to hitand a lower price target to contend with. Shares of the semiconductor inspection and process-control supplier rose 2.02% to $161.10 at 9:50 a.m. ET on November 2. Wells Fargo cut its target to $210 from $245 on October 29 while keeping an Overweight rating, The Fly reported. The firm remained positive on KLA's positioning for 2027, leaving the rating intact despite a 14.3% target reduction.

Warning! GuruFocus has detected 1 Warning Sign with SKHY.

Is KLAC fairly valued? Test your thesis with our free DCF calculator.

The operating outlook points higher. KLA's October 28 release put September-quarter revenue at $4.14 billion and projected December-quarter revenue of $4.7 billion, plus or minus $200 million. That midpoint implies roughly 13.5% sequential growth. Adjusted gross margin is forecast at 62.5%, plus or minus one percentage point, making profitability another key test as revenue expands.

The GuruFocus snapshot adds a valuation hurdle: KLA carries a 96/100 GF Score and trades at 40.25 times earnings. Profitability and growth stand out on the radar chart, while GF Value is its weakest dimension, suggesting business quality may offer more support than valuation. The next test is concrete: deliver revenue within the $4.5 billion$4.9 billion guidance range while protecting margins. Stronger sales could help rebuild confidence, but the earnings multiple leaves execution carrying considerable weight.

news.Title: Is UCTT Worth Buying as Growth Accelerates but Cash Flow Weakens?
news.Content:
Ultra Clean Holdings, Inc. UCTT is benefiting from accelerating semiconductor equipment demand, with earnings and profitability moving sharply higher. The investment question is whether that operating momentum can overcome weak cash conversion and a capital-intensive expansion cycle.

That trade-off is especially important because stronger reported profits have not yet translated into equally strong cash generation or capital returns. Investors must weigh improving estimates and margins against funding needs, customer concentration and execution risk.

UCTT's Earnings Momentum Is Building

Third-quarter 2026 adjusted earnings reached $1.15 per share, topping the Zacks Consensus Estimate of 91 cents by 26.4%. Revenues increased 48.8% year over year to $759 million and exceeded the consensus estimate by 4.6%.

The outlook points to another step up if current expectations hold. The Zacks Consensus Estimate calls for fiscal 2027 revenues of $3.788 billion and earnings of $6.63 per share, compared with projected 2026 revenues of $2.768 billion and earnings of $3.40 per share.

Ultra Clean Holdings, Inc. Price, Consensus and EPS Surprise

Ultra Clean Holdings, Inc. price-consensus-eps-surprise-chart | Ultra Clean Holdings, Inc. Quote

Ultra Clean Has a Clear Margin Opportunity

Profitability is improving as higher volumes increase factory utilization. Non-GAAP gross margin reached 17.3% in the third quarter, up from 16.7% sequentially, while non-GAAP operating margin expanded to 9% from 7%.

Management continues to target roughly 20% gross margin at about $4 billion of annual revenues. Higher utilization, greater vertical integration, a richer mix of engineered products and more production in lower-cost regions are expected to support that goal as capacity fills.

UCTT's Cash Conversion Is the Main Warning

The earnings improvement has not yet produced healthy cash conversion. Trailing 12-month cash-flow conversion was negative 244.4%, while free-cash-flow conversion was negative 418.5%, well below UCTT's historical medians.

Working capital is absorbing substantial cash. Inventory rose to $723.3 million, and operating activities used $42.3 million in the third quarter as Ultra Clean built critical components and safety stock. Trailing 12-month return on invested capital of 4.6% also remained below its 10-year company median of 9.8%.

Ultra Clean Still Carries Concentration Risk

Customer concentration remains a structural risk. Lam Research Corporation LRCX represented 39% of third-quarter revenues, while Applied Materials, Inc. AMAT accounted for 22%. Together, the two customers contributed 61%, leaving UCTT sensitive to their production schedules, sourcing decisions and wafer-fab-equipment spending.

Both customers are operating in supportive end markets. Lam reported September-quarter revenues of $8.22 billion and said AI was driving higher semiconductor demand and device complexity. Applied Materials posted record fiscal third-quarter revenues of $9.12 billion and cited AI-driven demand across leading-edge foundry-logic, DRAM and advanced packaging. Their strength supports the industry backdrop, but it does not remove UCTT's dependence on a small customer base.

Story Continues

UCTT's Ratings Favor Momentum Over Growth Quality

The bottom line is that UCTT offers accelerating earnings and a credible margin-expansion path, but the investment case is not clean. Cash conversion, low capital returns and concentration risk argue for discipline even as semiconductor demand strengthens.

UCTT currently carries a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), which is favorable from an earnings-estimate revision perspective. Its Momentum Score of A adds support for near-term price and earnings momentum. However, the Growth Score of D, Value Score of C and VGM Score of C indicate a less consistent profile across growth quality, valuation and combined style characteristics. That mix favors investors who prioritize momentum while recognizing that cash-flow and execution issues remain unresolved. news.Title: 3 Tech Stocks Boosting Buyback Capacity in the Face of the Sector's Recent Tumble
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Amphenol Corporation? Here are five stocks we like better.

Amid a tech sector sell-off, NXP Semiconductors, Amphenol and F5 announced large buyback authorizations signaling confidence in their future prospects.

NXP added $5 billion in buyback capacity as data center demand grows, while Amphenol unveiled a $4 billion repurchase program alongside a 20% dividend increase.

F5 announced an additional $1.5 billion buyback despite a 20.4% post-earnings stock drop, and analysts see over 40% upside for Amphenol shares.

Investors have hit tech stocks hard over the past few weeks. The Technology Select Sector SPDR Fund (NYSEARCA: XLK), a commonly used proxy for the sector's performance, is down more than 7% in October. Fears around the AI buildout's sustainability and disappointing earnings reports from Big Tech have been key drivers of the decline.

Amid the sell-off, three notable tech stocks are signaling confidence in the future by announcing substantial buyback authorizations. This list includes one name that has ridden the AI wave higher and higher, and others that are just now starting to participate more meaningfully.

→ L3Harris Stock Took a Beating—Is a 20% Rebound Next?

NXP's Data Center Demand Picks Up, Adds Huge Buyback Capacity

First up is NXP Semiconductors (NASDAQ: NXPI), a chip stock that is up approximately 17% in 2026. NXP's business primarily serves automotive and industrial customers. While NXP has not been a huge AI winner thus far, data center demand is starting to pick up, with the company expecting its data center revenue to exceed $500 million in 2026. NXP believes this business will scale to over $1 billion in the coming years, and sees physical AI as a long-term growth opportunity.

During its latest earnings call, the firm made a significant buyback announcement, adding an incremental $5 billion in repurchase capacity. This brings the company's total buyback capacity to $6.3 billion. With a market capitalization near $66 billion, this represents around 9.5% of the firm's value, giving it substantial buyback firepower.

→ Marvell Eyes a Swing for the AI Networking Fences as Markets Weigh Lumentum Price Tag

The company also notes that the authorization positions it to accelerate buybacks beginning in Q4, suggesting that its repurchases will increase compared to recent quarters. In Q3, the company spent $103 million on buybacks, significantly below its long-term average.

The planned acceleration suggests the company may see its shares as a strong value at recent levels.

Story Continues

→ Starbucks Says Its Turnaround Is Done—The Numbers Make a Strong Case (With 1 Catch)

AI Winner Amphenol Announces $4 Billion Buyback Program

In contrast to NXP, Amphenol (NYSE: APH) has been a massive beneficiary of the AI boom so far. The stock has posted a moderate but still strong return near 18% in 2026. This comes after shares soared 41% in 2024 and another 96% in 2025.

The connector, cable and sensor maker saw its revenue rise 65% year-over-year (YOY) last quarter to a record $10.2 billion. The company's acquisition of CommScope significantly increased its growth rate, but sales still grew by 37% YOY on an organic basis. Meanwhile, orders increased 99% YOY, with a book-to-bill ratio of 1.19:1, signaling continued demand momentum.

Amphenol indicated confidence in its long-term outlook by announcing a three-year, $4 billion repurchase program. This plan will become effective at the beginning of 2027, with the firm expecting to exhaust the capacity under its previous program by the end of 2026.

Given Amphenol's size, the program represents only about 2.1% of its market capitalization. However, the company is also returning more capital to shareholders through higher dividends. Amphenol announced a 20% dividend increase, after accounting for its recent stock split, moving its payout to 15 cents per share. Amphenol's forward yield is approximately 0.77%.

F5 Holds Huge Buyback Capacity After Dramatic Sell-Off

Last up is cybersecurity company F5 (NASDAQ: FFIV). Despite the market clobbering shares after its latest earnings report, F5 has performed strongly in 2026, up around 32%. Prior to its 20.4% post-earnings drop, F5 shares were up around 80% on the year.

This decline came even as F5 handily beat estimates on sales and earnings per share (EPS). Revenue increased by 13% YOY to $917 million, around $33 million higher than expected. Meanwhile, EPS of $4.42 was 16 cents higher than expected. The company also saw its AI-related offerings exceed $100 million in bookings, up 300% YOY. The bookings primarily came from AI data delivery offerings.

F5 pointed to a slowdown in its forecast for fiscal year 2027, projecting revenue growth of 8% to 9%, down from 11% in 2026.

The company also cited margin pressure as it grapples with higher component costs and invests in pursuing AI opportunities. These factors influenced the stock's sell-off.

During its earnings call, F5 announced an additional $1.5 billion share repurchase program, bringing its total capacity to $1.8 billion. One silver lining of F5's stock price decline is that this added capacity can now buy back many more shares than it otherwise could. F5's buyback capacity is now equal to around 9% of its market capitalization, a hefty figure.

Analysts Eye 40% Upside in Amphenol

Analysts see substantial upside ahead for Amphenol, even after the stock's impressive gains over the past few years. The MarketBeat consensus price target near $112 implies more than 40% upside.

IT datacom sales represented 48% of the company's revenue last quarter, and three-fourths of those sales were related to AI. IT datacom also drove massive growth, increasing 117% YOY in the United States. In turn, Amphenol's fortunes largely depend on the continued expansion of AI data centers, making hyperscaler capital expenditure guidance for 2027 critical to watch.

news.Title: Deciphering KLA (KLAC) International Revenue Trends
news.Content:
Have you looked into how KLA (KLAC) performed internationally during the quarter ending September 2026? Considering the widespread global presence of this maker of equipment for manufacturing semiconductors, examining the trends in international revenues is essential for assessing its financial resilience and prospects for growth.

In the modern, closely-knit global economic landscape, the capacity of a business to access foreign markets is often a key determinant of its financial well-being and growth path. Investors now place great importance on grasping the extent of a company's dependence on international markets, as it sheds light on the firm's earnings stability, its skill in leveraging various economic cycles and its broad growth potential.

International market involvement serves as insurance against economic downturns at home and enables engagement with economies that are growing more quickly. Still, this move toward diversification is not without its challenges, as it involves navigating through the fluctuations of currencies, geopolitical threats, and the distinctive nature of various markets.

While analyzing KLAC's performance for the last quarter, we found some intriguing trends in revenues from its overseas segments that Wall Street analysts commonly model and monitor.

The company's total revenue for the quarter amounted to $4.14 billion, showing rise of 28.9%. We will now explore the breakdown of KLAC's overseas revenue to assess the impact of its international operations.

Unveiling Trends in KLAC's International Revenues

During the quarter, Europe & Israel contributed $194.33 million in revenue, making up 4.7% of the total revenue. When compared to the consensus estimate of $180.94 million, this meant a surprise of +7.4%. Looking back, Europe & Israel contributed $355.64 million, or 9.7%, in the previous quarter, and $150.98 million, or 4.7%, in the same quarter of the previous year.

Of the total revenue, $497.17 million came from Korea during the last fiscal quarter, accounting for 12%. This represented a surprise of -27.28% as analysts had expected the region to contribute $683.66 million to the total revenue. In comparison, the region contributed $374.09 million, or 10.2%, and $299.37 million, or 9.3%, to total revenue in the previous and year-ago quarters, respectively.

Taiwan generated $1.02 billion in revenues for the company in the last quarter, constituting 24.7% of the total. This represented a surprise of -10.69% compared to the $1.15 billion projected by Wall Street analysts. Comparatively, in the previous quarter, Taiwan accounted for $1.14 billion (31.1%), and in the year-ago quarter, it contributed $793.61 million (24.7%) to the total revenue.

Story Continues

Japan accounted for 3.9% of the company's total revenue during the quarter, translating to $159.78 million. Revenues from this region represented a surprise of -53.19%, with Wall Street analysts collectively expecting $341.37 million. When compared to the preceding quarter and the same quarter in the previous year, Japan contributed $210.48 million (5.8%) and $295.21 million (9.2%) to the total revenue, respectively.

China accounted for 34.5% of the company's total revenue during the quarter, translating to $1.43 billion. Revenues from this region represented a surprise of +41.88%, with Wall Street analysts collectively expecting $1 billion. When compared to the preceding quarter and the same quarter in the previous year, China contributed $956.73 million (26.2%) and $1.27 billion (39.5%) to the total revenue, respectively.

During the quarter, Rest of Asia contributed $218.23 million in revenue, making up 5.3% of the total revenue. When compared to the consensus estimate of $140.74 million, this meant a surprise of +55.06%. Looking back, Rest of Asia contributed $158.04 million, or 4.3%, in the previous quarter, and $105.47 million, or 3.3%, in the same quarter of the previous year.

Revenue Projections for Overseas Markets

The current fiscal quarter's total revenue for KLA, as projected by Wall Street analysts, is expected to reach $4.71 billion, reflecting an increase of 43% from the same quarter last year. The breakdown of this revenue by foreign region is as follows: Europe & Israel is anticipated to contribute 4.4% or $207.61 million, Korea 15.7% or $737.99 millionTaiwan 28.5% or $1.34 billionJapan 8.9% or $417.55 millionChina 24.5% or $1.16 billion and Rest of Asia 3.4% or $161.39 million.

For the full year, the company is projected to achieve a total revenue of $18.3 billion, which signifies a rise of 34.7% from the last year. The share of this revenue from various regions is expected to be: Europe & Israel at 4.7% ($865.98 million), Korea at 16.1% ($2.95 billion), Taiwan at 29.4% ($5.38 billion), Japan at 8.6% ($1.58 billion), China at 26.4% ($4.83 billion), and Rest of Asia at 3.8% ($698.85 million).

The Bottom Line

KLA's leaning on foreign markets for its revenue stream presents a mix of chances and challenges. Therefore, a vigilant watch on its international revenue movements can greatly aid in projecting the company's future direction.

In a world where international interdependencies and geopolitical conflicts are ever-increasing, Wall Street analysts closely monitor these trends for companies having international presence to adjust their earnings forecasts. Of course, there are several other factors, including a company's standing within its home borders, that influence analysts' earnings forecasts.

We at Zacks strongly focus on the dynamic earnings forecast of companies, given that empirical studies have demonstrated its potent impact on the immediate price movement of stocks. Invariably, there's a positive relationship -- upward earnings predictions often result in an increase in stock prices.

Boasting a remarkable track record that's been externally verified, the Zacks Rank, our unique stock rating system, leverages changes in earnings projections to function as a reliable gauge for predicting short-term stock price movements.

Currently, KLA holds a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy), signifying its potential to outperform the overall market's performance in the forthcoming period. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) stocks here >>>> .

Assessing KLA's Stock Price Movement in Recent Times

The stock has witnessed a decline of 23.7% over the past month versus the Zacks S&P 500 composite's a decrease of 0.9%. In the same interval, the Zacks Computer and Technology sector, to which KLA belongs, has registered a decrease of 9.9%. Over the past three months, the company's shares saw a decrease of 20.3%, while the S&P 500 increased by 2.2%. In comparison, the sector experienced a decline of 0.8% during this timeframe.

news.Title: STMicroelectronics Could Reach New Highs—Here's What Needs to Happen
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in STMicroelectronics N.V.? Here are five stocks we like better.

STMicroelectronics stock, despite a near 50% correction in 2026, is technically positioned for a third Elliott Wave move toward fresh all-time highs.

The company posted Q3 revenue of $3.76 billion, up 17.9%, with widening margins, surging free cash flow, and bullish guidance pointing to mid-20% growth in Q4.

Analysts maintain a consensus Moderate Buy rating with 50% upside potential.

STMicroelectronics (NYSE: STM) stock price action is set up for a big move that could take it to all-time highs. While STM suffered an ugly price correction of nearly 50%, which suggested a market implosion, investors shouldn't get it wrong.

The correction that took place in Q2 and Q3 2026 was a mechanism within a rapidly swelling market.

→ L3Harris Stock Took a Beating—Is a 20% Rebound Next?

STM's fundamental story is a legacy business becoming a next-gen AI enabler, with rapidly expanding margins and ample free cash flow, cementing its already central position in the tech landscape.

The stock price story follows suit: a legacy market transitioning to one in which free cash flow is growing at a high triple-digit pace, expected to remain strong in the coming year and underpin capital returns.

→ Starbucks Says Its Turnaround Is Done—The Numbers Make a Strong Case (With 1 Catch)

The shift is reflected in trading volume, which took a decidedly bullish turn in 2024 and has trended higher ever since.

Technically, STM is in the midst of an Elliott Wave cycle that has yet to play out.

→ Marvell Eyes a Swing for the AI Networking Fences as Markets Weigh Lumentum Price Tag

The initial and second upwaves are complete, and the market is set up for a third move that could take STM's price to fresh highs.

Strong Q3 Results and Bullish Guidance Set the Stage for 2027

STMicroelectronics posted a solid Q3, with revenue up 17.9% to $3.76 billion, narrowly beating consensus. Growth was broad across channels, led by a 46% increase in the RF Optical segment, critical for data centers and high-speed data transmission. By end market, sales to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) grew 10.2%, while sales to distribution centers rose nearly 39%, and total sales are expected to remain strong in the coming quarters as demand outpaces supply.

Margin news was mixed, but with a silver lining. The company missed consensus for adjusted earnings because higher capital expenditure (CapEx) obscured strengths revealed by internal metrics. Gross and operating margins widened by more than 400 basis points, driving triple-digit increases in cash and free cash flow. Operating cash flow more than doubled to $1.02 billion, leaving free cash flow (FCF) at $351 million, despite higher CapEx, up 2.7x from the prior year and a 9.3% FCF margin.

Story Continues

Guidance is a catalyst for this market, likely to be compounded by similarly strong results and forecasts in the upcoming quarters. STM provided a hot guide for Q4, expecting revenue above consensus, up more than 10% sequentially and accelerating into the mid-20% range versus last year. Factors suggesting the guide is cautious and that strengths will continue include the book-to-bill ratio, which came in well above 3. At this pace, the backlog is growing at three times the pace of revenue, setting the stage for a robust 2027.

Analysts and Institutions See 50% Upside for STMicroelectronics

Analysts expressed some caution in their initial responses to the earnings release, highlighting high expectations and the potential for investors to be dissatisfied with the gross margin, as good as it was.

That said, the net response reaffirmed the consensus Moderate Buy rating and the forecast for 50% upside, with analysts focused on the growth trajectory, cash flow, and expansion plans.

CapEx increases fund a multi-year AI-focused expansion plan. It aims to optimize existing capacity and focus on optical connectivity, the key to unlocking AI's power.

Institutions and other sell-side interests reflect confidence in this stock and its value. Institutions own about 75% of the stock across U.S. and home-listed shares and are accumulating it at discounted prices.

Short-sellers, the other sell-side interest, are largely absent, providing no headwind for share prices. The likely outcome is that institutions continue to support the market at or near $45, if not slowly lift support over time, providing a base for the next big rally.

STMicroelectronics Has Major Catalysts Ahead

STMicroelectronics has three big catalysts that can trigger its rebound and sustain the upward trajectory: margin recovery, an EV inflection, and monetizing its investments in optical connects.

Margin recovery is expected to continue in Q4, potentially to pre-expansion levels. If so, it signals successful optimization and may prompt aggressive re-rating from analysts.

The EV inflection is an industry-wide phenomenon underpinned by inventory normalization and may generate a definitive data point in STM's upcoming report, another catalyst for analysts.

Monetization of AI investments is the final piece, cementing the company's transition to a next-gen AI enabler.

Risks include execution, with manufacturing footprint changes key to expansion, customer concentration, and end-market cyclicality. Clients are centered in big-name hyperscalers and Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL), which accounts for a low-double-digit percentage of revenue, while market cyclicality may soon end. The automotive market is the root of cyclical weaknesses, which may be mitigated by the rise of physical AI and the Internet of Things (IoT), which will rely on many of the same microcontrol products.

news.Title: 櫃買指數逆勢翻紅漲近1%！分析師點名環球晶當「多頭司令」
news.Content:
台股今（2）日一度挫逾800點，但櫃買指數卻率先由黑翻紅，盤中上漲近1%，表現相對強勢。啟發投顧分析師丁彥鈞表示，櫃買指數主要是技術面跌深反彈，KD指標已降至20附近，但不代表長線跌勢結束，後續仍可能有約1成修正空間。若上櫃股展開反彈，他看好群聯（8299）、環球晶（6488），其中又以環球晶有望成為上櫃股反彈的「多頭司令」。

觀察今日盤勢，櫃買指數早盤最低下探362.18點，隨後買盤回流，由黑翻紅，盤中最高來到373.22點。相較加權指數，中小型股表現相對強勢。

丁彥鈞指出，櫃買指數近期已跌破半年線，技術面明顯轉弱，但隨著KD指標降至20附近，短線出現跌深反彈。他強調，今天盤中翻紅主要是技術性反彈。

丁彥鈞表示，櫃買指數目前本益比約25.77倍，仍處於相對偏高水準，若未來美國升息、外資持續賣超，本益比可能向20倍靠攏，但不代表指數還會再下跌2成，因為企業的獲利有成長，預估櫃買指數可能再下跌1成左右。

至於哪些上櫃股有機會率先帶動反彈，丁彥鈞點名群聯及環球晶，認為兩家公司基本面較佳，有望成為後續反彈的觀察指標。若只能選出一檔作為「多頭司令」，他則看好環球晶，主要是環球晶位於半導體產業上游，對景氣變化的反應較為敏感。

丁彥鈞也預估，櫃買指數350點附近有機會形成支撐，跌破的機率不高。不過，他提醒，短線跌深反彈與長線趨勢反轉仍有差別，投資人不宜僅因指數盤中翻紅，就認定修正行情已經結束。

湯暖萱／財經特派記者，主跑主計處、營建、百貨紡織等
